stages:
Generative models can expand
candidate enumeration at low marginal cost.

Automated synthesis and DNA libraries
can expand construction capacity.

Illustrative capacity expansion
that investors would need to fund.

Patients, ethics, capital and time
remain hard constraints.

Clinical success must be demonstrated;
AI does not establish an approval rate.

ecosystem.title: Molecular construction
ecosystem.products:
DNA / RNA synthesis, enzymes
Chemical building blocks
ecosystem.companies: GenScript — 1548.HK | Vazyme — 688105.SH | Tsingke — NEEQ:874813 | Twist Bioscience — NASDAQ:TWST | Thermo Fisher — NYSE:TMO
ecosystem.mechanism: More physical candidates can require more custom DNA, enzymes and chemical building blocks. Better computational triage can reduce how many candidates need to be constructed.
ecosystem.watch: Paid construct volumes, turnaround time, synthesis success and net price per construct.
ecosystem.boundary: China oligonucleotide synthesis services RMB0.53bn plus long-fragment synthesis RMB0.80bn. This excludes the broader upstream equipment and reagent market.

ecosystem.title: Protein & functional assays
ecosystem.products:
Recombinant proteins, antibodies
Binding and activity assays
ecosystem.companies: ACROBiosystems — 301080.SZ | Sino Biological — 301047.SZ | Bio-Techne — NASDAQ:TECH | Thermo Fisher — NYSE:TMO
ecosystem.mechanism: Physical expression and binding or activity tests can translate designed proteins into recurring reagent demand. Experimental success, assay intensity and miniaturization determine the net effect.
ecosystem.watch: Non-COVID research orders, functional product mix, customer repeat purchases and overseas demand.
ecosystem.boundary: Research-use recombinant proteins, not therapeutic protein manufacturing. The China estimate of ~US$0.4bn is rounded to US$0.1bn precision.

ecosystem.title: Cells & culture systems
ecosystem.products:
Cell models, media, feeds
Bioreactors and cell expansion
ecosystem.companies: OPM Biosciences — 688293.SH | ACROBiosystems — 301080.SZ | Gibco / Thermo Fisher — NYSE:TMO | Cytiva / HyClone / Danaher — NYSE:DHR
ecosystem.note: Selected media anchor; not all cell tools
ecosystem.mechanism: Cell models validate whether a candidate works in a biological system. The displayed market anchor is bioprocess media, whose demand depends more on culture volume and drug output than virtual design counts.
ecosystem.watch: Culture volumes, feeds and media intensity, validated processes and manufacturing utilization.
ecosystem.boundary: China bioprocess cell culture media. It does not size all research media, cell models, bioreactors or cellular tools. Filing footnote excludes the COVID impact on vaccine products.

ecosystem.title: Labware & sample handling
ecosystem.products:
Tips, plates, tubes, filtration
Automation-compatible labware
ecosystem.companies: JET Biofil — 688026.SH | Changhong — 300151.SZ | Corning — NYSE:GLW | BD — NYSE:BDX · specimen collection
ecosystem.mechanism: More tests can use more plates, tips, tubes and sample-preparation products. Smaller volumes, denser plates and tip-free dispensing can offset the experiment count increase.
ecosystem.watch: Automation qualification, repeat orders, plate density, units per test, prices and utilization.
ecosystem.boundary: Disposable plastic biological laboratory consumables in China, including research, clinical and industrial applications. Company-cited approximate industry estimate. BD is shown for the adjacent clinical/preanalytical sampling workflow; its ticker BDX does not represent the former BD flow-cytometry business.

ecosystem.title: Measurement & analytics
ecosystem.products:
Sequencing, LC / LC-MS, flow
Imaging and quality control
ecosystem.companies: MGI — 688114.SH | NanoMicro / NanoChrom — 688690.SH | Illumina — NASDAQ:ILMN | Agilent — NYSE:A | Waters — NYSE:WAT · includes former BD flow
global: Waters — NYSE:WAT · includes former BD flow
ecosystem.mechanism: Sequencing, mass spectrometry, flow and imaging create the measurements that close the feedback loop. Equipment purchases depend on new installations, replacement cycles and throughput utilization. Former BD Biosciences/flow is now part of Waters (WAT), following the 9 February 2026 transaction.
ecosystem.watch: Funded installations, utilization, reagent pull-through, service attachment and application mix.
ecosystem.boundary: The displayed China anchor is sequencing instruments plus consumables, including clinical uses. It is not a combined TAM for LC/MS, flow, imaging and sequencing.

ecosystem.title: Purification & scale-up
ecosystem.products:
Analytical columns, process resins
Filtration and single-use systems
ecosystem.companies: NanoMicro — 688690.SH | Suzhou Sepax — 688758.SH | Cytiva / Danaher — NYSE:DHR | Repligen — NASDAQ:RGEN
ecosystem.note: Manufacturing demand has a longer lag
ecosystem.mechanism: Purification and analytical chromatography support development. Manufacturing resin demand requires successful pipeline progression and physical drug output; resin reuse can weaken the relationship with batch counts.
ecosystem.watch: Customer qualification, commercial batch volumes, resin reuse cycles, utilization and overseas orders.
ecosystem.boundary: China bioprocess chromatography resins, not all analytical columns, chemical adsorption resins or purification instruments. Filing footnote excludes the COVID impact on vaccine products.

sources_note: Media and resin anchors were checked against the official filing index during the preceding research on 9–10 October 2026. Direct PDF access is currently unavailable. Values carry an asterisk and lower source-access confidence.
ticker_note: Examples grouped by listing venues, not domicile; Gibco uses Thermo Fisher TMO, Cytiva/HyClone use Danaher DHR. BD BDX is sample collection; former BD flow maps to Waters WAT. Tsingke 874813 is NEEQ-listed.
